comment: She is so nice and really doesn't expect too much out of her students. She understands we have a lot on our plate and really just wants us to learn without being stressed. As long as you show up and listen to her lectures, which are usually interesting and fun to listen to, you will do well in the class. Highly recommend taking a class with her.

Professor Stravitz is so sweet and nice. But there is good and bad with her teaching style. Good: she lets you out of class early every class, barely any homework, and study guides for the exams. Bad: the lectures are too fast (not enough student discussion about ethics), other ethics class don't have sit down exams, and the exams are content heavy
No homework except to read on your assigned week and a paper. Final is easy if you follow the study guide... she is super nice
No homework. So helpful. Study guide given for final. Best teacher EVER!

Stravitz is cool- she is serious about the class but can be a lot of fun. She's really into professionalism so don't be late and turn everything in on time. You have to do the reading but she gives you a specific week where you're on call to answer questions on it. She's not an easy grader but she's helpful and you'll learn a lot
Professor Stravitz is a good professor. She can be pretty tough though, so you'll have to work hard. You have to do the reading and participate to pass, but she's a lot of help if you're struggling.

Professor Stravitz is definitely not easy, but she's really smart and gives a good lecture. She really values participation and professionalism and has high expectations. That being said, she is super flexible and makes herself available to students when they need her. Expect to work hard in this class, but you'll learn a ton.
